NO text, borders, grid, characters, scenery. Crisp chunky pixel clusters, limited palette 2 main colors plus bright cream highlight, dark colored edges. Classic tactical RPG mobile readable aesthetic. Each frame fits in central 70 percent of its cell with generous transparent margins; NOTHING touches cell boundaries. Identical scale and anchor for all frames, do not auto-fit frames. Animation frames: 1 small emergence,2 growing,3 stronger,4 peak,5 peak changing,6 dissolving,7 sparse remnants,8 tiny last particles. Fixed center at 50 percent x, 50 percent y of each cell.
